시편 55:1.content: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

시편 55:2.content: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

시편 55:3.content: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

시편 55:4.content: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

시편 55:5.content: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

시편 55:6.content: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

시편 55:7.content: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

시편 55:8.content: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

시편 55:9.content: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

시편 55:10.content: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

시편 55:11.content: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

시편 55:12.content: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

시편 55:13.content: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

시편 55:14.content: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

시편 55:15.content: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

시편 55:16.content: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

시편 55:17.content: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

시편 55:18.content: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

시편 55:19.content: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

시편 55:20.content: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

시편 55:21.content: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

시편 55:22.content: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

시편 55:23.content: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
